text: Hello and welcome to live coverage of the Premier League meeting between Brighton and Hove Albion and Luton Town at the Amex Stadium!

Luton are playing their first ever Premier League game, and making their first appearance in the top-flight since May 1992, in which time they dropped out of the Football League and worked their way back up again.
They finished third in the Championship last season, and earned promotion through the play-offs, beating Coventry City on penalties in the final.
They have won three of their six pre-season games coming into today (D2 L1).
As for Brighton, they come into this campaign on the back of their highest ever finish in the top-flight after finishing sixth last season and claiming a spot in the Europa League.
They only had a short pre-season and won just one of their four games (D1 L2).
Roberto De Zerbi hands competitive debuts to midfield pairing Dahoud and Milner, as well as Pedro, who partners Welbeck up top.
Other new signings Verbruggen and Julio start on the bench.
There's no Moises Caicedo in the matchday squad amidst his possible transfer away from the club.
There are five players making their competitive debuts for Rob Edwards' team today.
Kaminski starts in goal, with Giles, Chong, Andersen and Nakamba also getting starts.
Brown and Ogbene will have to wait to make their impact from the bench, while there's no Ross Barkley in the squad.
They are also without Jordan Clark and Daniel Potts through injury.
This will be Luton's first top-flight game since a 2-1 loss to Notts County in May 1992.
They are the 51st team to play in the Premier League, with two of the last three clubs making their debut in the competition winning their opening match (Huddersfield in 2017, Brentford in 2021).
The teams are out on the pitch now, with kick-off just moments away!
Adebayo gets the game underway for Luton!
Brighton have made a bright start to the game and Milner wins an early corner.
It's swung deep into the far post and Mitoma keeps it alive so Dahoud can put it back into a danger zone.
Dunk meets it, but heads his effort high over the bar.
March is stopped in his tracks on the halfway line, and Andersen's first thought is to send it forward for Morris.
He darts down the left before fizzing a low cross in, but Steele gets down to collect.
WHAT A CHANCE! Estupinan slides a lovely throughball into Pedro on the edge of the box, but Lockyer takes it off his toe.
March latches onto the loose ball and squares it back to Pedro, who gets another chance, but he drags it wide.
Chong knocks the ball past Estupinan, who stands his ground and blocks his run.
He protests his innocence, but he is still shown the first yellow card of the game.
CHANCE! Pedro cuts inside from the left and pulls it back to Welbeck.
He is a long way out but the space opens up in front of him as it bounces invitingly.
He hits it on the half-volley, but there is not enough dip on it as it lands on the roof of the net.
Kabore's low cross isn't met by any of his team-mates, but Giles picks up the loose ball on the far side.
He whips an early cross in, looking for Ogbene, but Dunk coolly chests it back to Steele.
Brighton win a free-kick which is taken short to Estupinan.
He slides it forward for Mitoma, who has a better angle, but there's too much pace on the pass and it rolls out for a goal-kick.
It's another great run by Mitoma down the left and he clips a brilliant cross into the middle.
Gross beats Bell to it and his header loops towards Pedro, but Lockyer is there to clear it.
Luton are struggling to get close to the ball at the moment as Brighton settle into their rhythm.
It's played out to Mitoma again, but this time his cross is too close to Kaminski.
March is tripped by Nakamba and Brighton have a free-kick in a good position.
Gross rolls it backwards so March has a better angle, but he drills his long-range shot into the wall.
SAVE! March picks out Welbeck with a long throw-in, and he shrugs Lockyer off so that he can get into the box.
A quick glance up shows he has no support, and he hits his low shot straight at Kaminski.
It's patient play from Brighton as they play it between their defenders, trying to draw Luton out of their shape.
The visitors are happy for them to keep it for now though.
GOOD CHANCE! Kabore has acres of space down the right, and this time, he does pick out a team-mate with his cross.
Mpanzu makes a late run to the far post, but he thumps his header wide.
Brighton are back to dominating possession as they push Luton deeper into their own half.
Mitoma manages to squeeze it back to Dahoud, and after a heavy touch, he blazes a shot over.
Dahoud wins it back in midfield and tries to mount a quick counter through Pedro.
He tries to thread it through for Mitoma, but he's crowded off it by three Luton players.
Dahoud slips and it allows Adebayo to poke it forward for Mpanzu to drive down the left.
He cuts inside and tries to go for goal himself, but it's blocked by Van Hecke.
GOOD SAVE! It's spread out to the left again to Mitoma, who helps it to Pedro as he makes the overlapping run.
He curls a cross in for Welbeck, who hits the shot first time, but Kaminski stretches to tip it away as the offside flag goes up.
Brighton have only failed to score in one of their last 28 Premier League matches, netting in each of their last 16 in a row since a 1-0 home defeat to Fulham in February.
It's the Seagulls' longest scoring run in league football since a run of 22 between March and September 2011.
The cross comes in from March and it clears everyone in the middle.
Mitoa is unmarked on the far side, and it bounces up nicely in front of him.
He hits the half-volley, but sends it sailing over the bar.
MARCH SCORES! Once more, Luton struggle to cope with the threat that Mitoma offers down the left.
After keeping the move alive, it comes back to him on the corner of the box.
He clips a wonderful cross into March, who flicks it back towards the near post.
He gets enough height on it to beat Kaminski, and it's 1-0 Brighton!
Luton have players close to Mitoma, but none of them react quick enough to close him down before he puts the cross in.
GOOD SAVE! Luton go straight up the other end and win a corner which is whipped onto the edge of the six-yard box.
Morris makes a late run onto it and thumps a header on goal, but it's straight down the middle at Steele.
OFF THE POST! It's looped over the top to Estupinan, who pulls it back to Welbeck in the middle.
He slides in on the stretch to poke it towards goal, but it rebounds off the far post and back into a relieved Kaminski's arms.
It's a wonderful throughball from Dunk to pick out another surging run down the left by Mitoma.
He pulls it back towards Welbeck again, but it's just behind him and bounces off his heel to Andersen.
Mpanzu blocks Mitoma from latching onto a throughball and shields it out of play.
In his frustration, Mitoma kicks the ball away and picks up a booking.
March makes a diagonal cross-field run to latch onto another long ball over the top.
He bursts past Lockyer, but his cross is too close to Kaminski, who collects.
CHANCE! Luton have one last chance before the half-time whistle as it's floated into the box for Morris.
He sends a header back across goal that has Steele scrambling, but it bounces wide.
HALF-TIME: BRIGHTON AND HOVE ALBION 1-0 LUTON TOWN.
March's header gives Brighton a 1-0 lead over Luton at half-time.
It took 36 minutes for the hosts to break down Luton, and it came from Mitoma's cross on the left, with March flicking his header over Kaminski to open the scoring.
They'd already missed a glorious chance in the first five minutes as Pedro dragged a close-range effort wide.
Welbeck also hit the post, while Morris had two good opportunities at the other end, forcing Steele into a reflex save before heading wide just before the break.
Brighton had a good first half, and De Zerbi will be pleased with their performance for the most part.
They've got into some good positions, but they need to be more clinical.
Despite being behind, Luton have had some bright moments, especially as the half went on.
Edwards will be urging them to take a few more risks when they do get into the final third to try and punish Brighton.
Brighton get us back underway for the second half!
Brighton have made a bright start to the second half and are keeping Luton under pressure.
Pedro drops deep to get on the ball before making a weaving run into the box.
Mpanzu gets across to take all of the sting out of the shot.
Luton are pressing higher up the pitch, but they're struggling to get close to Brighton at the moment.
The hosts are confidently knocking it around and trying to open up the space.
Pedro nicks it off Andersen in the box before being forced wide by the defender.
When he tries to cut back into the box, Andersen blocks off his run and is booked for it.
OFF THE POST! Brighton's free-kick is just outside the box on the left, and March rolls it backwards to give Gross a better angle.
He keeps his shot low and it smacks the bottom of the near post.
Adebayo hooks it forward for Mpanzu and he tries to hold it up while he waits for support to get into the box.
His team-mates aren't quick enough though, and he's crowded off it.
Kabore tries to play a one-two with Morris as he cuts inside from the right, but the return pass is cut out.
There are shouts for a handball against Estupinan, but the referee waves play on.
Chong gets away with a loose pass before trying to spread it out to Giles on the left.
He's asking too much of him though, and Brighton are back in possession once more.
Mitoma gives Kabore the runaround before darting down the left to get the ball back.
Kabore is on the wrong side and just clips the winger as he cuts it out.
He picks up a yellow card.
Mpanzu slides in to try and win the ball off Milner, but he's penalised for it.
Gross whips a dangerous free-kick in from the right, but nobody can make contact with it.
GOOD SAVE! Gross backheels it to the edge of the box for March, who drops a shoulder to try and open up some space.
He does manage to get a shot away, but Kaminski gets behind it.
Luton are making a double-change as they look to get back into this game.
Adebayo is the first to go off, with Brown coming on to make his debut for the club.
And Kabore, who is on a booking, makes way for Doughty.
Brown gets straight into the action as he makes a driving run down the right.
His cross is deflected slightly, which just takes it away from Morris, who threw himself towards it at the far post.
Luton are starting to up the pressure here and Giles finds some space to attack down the left.
He whips a lovely cross into the box, but nobody makes the run to the far post for the visitors.
PENALTY TO BRIGHTON! Mitoma cuts inside from the left to slide in Pedro, and his first touch takes it away from him.
Lockyer rushes in and puts his arm across Pedro, who goes down, and the referee points straight to the spot.
PEDRO SCORES! After winning the penalty, Pedro steps up to take it and makes no mistake! He takes a short, stuttered run-up to the spot and fires his shot to the right.
Kaminski dives the right way, but it flies over him and into the back of the net to give Pedro a goal on his debut.
2-0 Brighton!
Brighton are still on the front foot and Luton are scrambling to get back into their shape.
Mitoma cuts inside from the left once more but is tripped by Mpanzu.
Brighton are making a double change now.
Dahoud is the first to go off, with Gilmour on in his place.
And March, who opened the scoring, is also taken off, with Adingra replacing him.
There's another debut for Luton now as Ogbene comes on in place of Andersen.
Brighton are making another double change.
Ferguson comes on for Welbeck.
And Milner is also taken off, with Veltman coming on in his place.
PENALTY TO LUTON! Brown has space to run down the right again and he swings a cross in.
Dunk throws himself forward to make the block and his arms are up.
It strikes the arm which is slightly behind him, and the referee points to the spot.
MORRIS SCORES! Luton have their first-ever Premier League goal! It's cool as you like from the spot by Morris as he takes a pause before striking it.
He rolls it into the bottom left corner, sending Steele the wrong way, and Luton are back into this game.

events.action: rolls it into the bottom left corner

text: Pedro plays the reverse pass down the left for Mitoma to chase and he pulls it back from the byline.
Adingra knocks it onto Ferguson, but Bell reacts quickly to stop him from reaching it.
ADRINGA SCORES! Luton are caught out trying to play it out from the back and Estupinan sees a shot pushed away by Kaminski.
Mpanzu brings it down on his chest and is too casual as he tries to pick out a pass.
He's dispossessed by Adringa, who punishes him by fizzing his low shot past the keeper.

events.action: fizzing his low shot past the keeper

text: 3-1 Brighton!
OFF THE POST! Brighton have the wind back in their sails and they're looking for another goal.
Ferguson spins away from a crowd just inside the box before firing a powerful shot on goal.
Kaminski is beaten, but it hits the inside of the post and bounces out.
Luton's final change is a double one.
Chong is the first to go off, with Berry on for him.
Mpanzu also makes way for Woodrow.
Brighton's last change sees Enciso come on for Pedro.
GOOD SAVE! It's another brilliant throughball into the box by Estupinan to pick out Gross' run.
He checks back, leaving Lockyer on the floor and he hits a low shot at the near post, but Kaminski gets down to deny him.
We're into seven added minutes at the end of the game, as Brighton push forward once more.
Their corner is taken short to Estupinan, who curls it into the far post, but it's just too high for Dunk.
GREAT SAVE! Luton are looking to get another goal here as it's nodded back across the box by Woodrow.
He picks out Morris, who hits it on the volley just inside the box, and Steele stretches to tip it over.
Luton are looking to make a strong finish to the game as they keep Brighton penned back in their own half.
Giles finds space to clip in another cross from the left, but this one is too close to Steele.
FERGUSON SCORES! Dunk sends a wonderful long ball over the top for Estupinan to chase and he has time to square it across the box to the far post.
Adringa is running onto it, but Ferguson slides in to get there first and turn it in from close range.
4-1 Brighton!
None of the Luton defenders picked up Estupinan's run and he had time to get his head up and spot the runs into the far post.
FULL-TIME: BRIGHTON AND HOVE ALBION 4-1 LUTON TOWN.
Brighton's season gets off to a winning start as they beat newly-promoted Luton 4-1.
They led 1-0 at the break through March's headed goal but could've had more as Pedro spurned a glorious chance from close range and Welbeck hit the post.
Pedro did double their lead in the second half, winning a penalty and then converting it, before Morris pulled one back from the spot at the other end after Dunk's handball.
Adringa latched onto a mistake at the back to restore their two-goal cushion, with Ferguson then hitting the post a minute later.
The young striker added a fourth late in stoppage time, sliding in to score at the far post.
Brighton put three points on the board, and turn their attention to their trip to Wolves next weekend.
Luton's first ever Premier League game ends in defeat, and they're not in action for two weeks with their home match against Burnley postponed due to the work being done at Kenilworth Road.
They'll face Chelsea in their next outing.
That's all, goodbye!
